summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of ArthaKu (Indonesian personal finance tracker). Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass covering health, auth (mock session token via Bearer/cookie), categories auto-seed (12 defaults), category CRUD (block default deletion), transaction CRUD with filters, reports summary for all 4 periods (daily/monthly/3months/yearly), PDF+Excel export MIME/content validation, per-user data isolation (User B cannot see/modify/reuse User A's data), and logout invalidates session. Frontend: mock session cookie authenticated all protected routes; verified login page, dashboard KPI cards + period filters + recent list, add-transaction flow via modal (type tabs, amount, category select, description, save), transactions table listing, Reports page PDF + Excel downloads (real files received), Settings accent color change + dark mode toggle + custom category add, and logout redirect to /login.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description prop (a11y warning only, not blocking)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix DialogContent components in TransactionModal and Settings category dialog to remove console a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth cookie is set with samesite='none' + secure=True + httpOnly=True; works only over HTTPS (preview URL is HTTPS, OK). Backend correctly falls back to Authorization: Bearer, so Postman/curl work.
All Mongo reads use {"_id": 0} projection - no ObjectId leaks.
created_at datetimes are stored as ISO strings after insert - consistent; expires_at is stored as native Date in exchange path and as ISO in mock scripts; get_current_user handles both. Good.
get_or_create_user swallows non-email session_data with KeyError; not critical because exchange_session_id validates upstream, but a defensive guard would be nicer.
Reports summary casts amounts float-safe and returns sorted category_breakdown; savings_rate returns 0 when income==0 (safe).
Frontend axios uses withCredentials=true - cookie-based auth is consistent.
Nice separation of routes into modules; server.py stays small (~90 lines).
No rate limiting / no CSRF on state-changing endpoints - acceptable for MVP but note for production.
test_credentials: Mock session created via mongosh inserting into users + user_sessions (test_database). Real Google OAuth verified only visually (button + redirect target).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral mock users (TESTA_, TESTB_, TESTL_, TESTUI_) created and cleaned up in pytest fixtures / after UI run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_arthaku_api.py + conftest.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env vars. Fixtures auto-create mock users/sessions and clean up. Frontend must authenticate by inserting into users + user_sessions collections and setting the session_token cookie (httpOnly, secure, sameSite=None) on the preview domain.
